app.name: Atelier
app.tagline: Handmade, by the hands that made it

rules.message: Only Atelier curators can approve a piece.
rules.check: const isAdmin = await ctx.me('admin'); if (isAdmin) return true; const prev = ctx.old ? String(ctx.old.status) : ''; if (String(row.status) === 'approved' && prev !== 'approved') return 'Only Atelier curators can approve a piece.'; if (Number(row.price) < 0 || Number(row.stock) < 0) return 'Price and stock cannot be negative.'; return true;

const r = await ctx.db.query('select seller_id, stock, status, title from product where id = $1', [row.product_id]); const rows = Array.isArray(r) ? r : (r && r.rows) || []; const p = rows[0]; if (!p) return 'That piece no longer exists.'; if (String(p.status) !== 'approved') return 'That piece is not available yet.'; const q = Number(row.quantity); if (!(q >= 1)) return 'Choose at least one.'; if (q > Number(p.stock)) return 'Only ' + Number(p.stock) + ' of ' + String(p.title) + ' left in stock — you asked for ' + q + '.'; const me = await ctx.me('seller'); const myId = me && typeof me === 'object' ? String(me.id) : (me ? String(me) : ''); if (myId && myId === String(p.seller_id)) return 'You can\'t buy your own piece.'; return true;

seller.name: Aiko Tanaka
seller.story: I dye silk and linen in indigo vats my grandmother taught me to tend. Each fold and binding is done by hand, so every scarf carries its own pattern.

seller.name: Nora Lindqvist
seller.story: I knit from undyed merino sourced from a family farm two hours north. Everything is made to keep winter feeling like a gift.

seller.name: Jonah Pierce
seller.story: Poured in tiny batches in a converted garage, scented with essential oils and cured for two full weeks before they leave the studio.

seller.name: Priya Nair
seller.story: I melt reclaimed brass and shape it by hand into light, everyday jewellery inspired by the backwaters I grew up beside.

seller.name: Imogen Hale
seller.story: I throw every piece on a wheel I bought second-hand in 2014, then fire it in a tiny gas kiln behind my flat. Glazes are mixed from ash, clay and a lot of patience — no two mugs ever match.

seller.name: Tomás Rivera
seller.tagline: Slow-cut wood, finished with oil and time
seller.story: Third-generation carpenter. I only work with fallen walnut, oak and olive wood from neighbouring orchards, and finish everything with beeswax and linseed oil.

product.title: Raku Crackle Dish
product.description: A footed dish raku-fired and smoked, so the white glaze crazes into a fine web of dark lines. Decorative; not for food.

product.title: Salt-glazed Bud Vase
product.description: A small vase salt-fired for a subtle orange-peel texture, shown here beside a jug from the same firing. Holds a single stem or a loose handful.

product.title: Cable-knit Throw
product.description: A heavy cable-knit blanket for sofas and cold evenings. Made to order in about two weeks, currently between batches.

product.title: Leaf-print Porcelain Cup
product.description: A straight-sided cup with a real leaf pressed into the clay before firing, then glazed in a soft celadon. Holds a generous 250ml.

product.title: Walnut & Maple Inlay Tray
product.description: A serving tray with a hand-cut marquetry top of walnut and maple triangles, sealed with hard-wax oil. Every triangle is cut and fitted by hand.

product.title: Walnut Serving Board
product.description: Cut from a single fallen walnut slab, with a live edge and a leather hanging loop. Big enough for a proper cheese board for six. Finished with food-safe oil and beeswax.

product.title: Oak Wall Pegs (Set of 3)
product.description: Turned oak pegs with a slight upward tilt, for coats, bags or a market basket. Each is turned by hand, so no two are quite the same. Fixings included.

product.title: Block-printed Cotton Scarf
product.description: Soft cotton voile printed by hand with carved wooden blocks, one colour at a time. Each scarf is printed to order, so the pattern you get is yours alone.

product.title: Linen Waffle Robe
product.description: A knee-length robe in waffle-woven linen that gets softer with every wash. Hung here in the studio beside our bath towels.

product.title: Merino Rib Jumper
product.description: A close-fitting rib jumper in undyed merino, knitted slowly on a hand-frame. Warm without the itch, and easy to layer.

product.title: Hand-thrown Fruit Bowl
product.description: A wide, shallow bowl with a pale celadon interior, thrown in one piece. Beautiful holding lemons, or nothing at all.

product.title: Beeswax Taper Set
product.description: Six hand-dipped beeswax tapers with a honeyed scent.

product.title: Brass Hoop Earrings
product.description: Light, hammered hoops cast from reclaimed brass. Hypoallergenic posts, 35mm.

product.title: Cedar & Fig Soy Candle
product.description: A 220g candle with notes of cedar, green fig and a little smoke. Around 45 hours of slow, clean burn.
product.materials: Soy wax, cotton wick, essential oils

product.title: Beech Garment Hangers (Set of 6)
product.description: Slim hangers shaped from a single piece of beech, with a brass hook and a notched shoulder for straps. Kind to knitwear.

workflows.title: Order placed: reserve stock and tell the maker

do.code: const p = await ctx.db.get('product', String(row.product_id)); if (p) { const left = Math.max(0, Number(p.stock) - Number(row.quantity)); await ctx.db.update('product', String(p.id), { stock: left }); ctx.log('stock now ' + left); }

workflows.title: A successful payment marks the order paid

do.code: const o = await ctx.db.get('order', String(row.order_id)); if (o && String(row.state) === 'succeeded' && String(o.status) === 'placed') { await ctx.db.update('order', String(o.id), { status: 'paid' }); ctx.log('order ' + String(o.id) + ' marked paid'); }
